Instrument samples used by the sound engine (static/audio/instruments.js)

fluidr3-gm/drawbar_organ/*.mp3, fluidr3-gm/reed_organ/*.mp3, fluidr3-gm/woodblock/*.mp3

  Source:  "Fluid (R3) General MIDI SoundFont" (FluidR3_GM.sf2) by Frank Wen,
           as pre-rendered MP3 notes in the MIDI.js soundfonts by Benjamin Gleitzman:
           https://github.com/gleitz/midi-js-soundfonts, FluidR3_GM/<instrument>-mp3.js,
           commit 044fab8e1456bfafc5776e86dfd6bb8697149aef (gh-pages, 2021-12-17).
  Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 (CC BY 3.0), as stated by the midi-js-soundfonts
           README for the Fluid soundfont: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/
           (The repository's own MIT licence covers its code, not the samples.)
  Changes: each note's MP3 was base64-decoded out of the MIDI.js file and saved as its own
           file, byte for byte; only every third semitone from C2 to C7 (and C5, C6 of the
           woodblock) was kept. The audio itself is not modified on disk. At runtime the
           engine mixes each sample to mono and trims its leading silence.
